name: db-query
description: Official scenario suite for precise natural-language data retrieval against business databases. Enforces semantic-layer binding (metric definitions, default filters, table whitelist, row-level security), generates SQL via NL2SQL with sql.validate self-correction, executes on a read replica under cost/approval gates, and attaches citation chips (metric version / table / example / rules). Includes 4 skills and 4 quick commands.
descriptionEn: Official scenario suite for precise natural-language data retrieval against business databases. Enforces semantic-layer binding, NL2SQL with validation self-correction, read-replica execution under cost gates, and citation chips. 4 skills + 4 quick commands.
